scope: Two artificial end-to-end recovery controls; no actual supernova fit or empirical theory validation.
source_spectrum: Flat fnu between 1000 and 20000 angstrom; one common luminosity and duration across all distances, no source evolution.
injection: Independent analytic fixed-band formula, shared linear Gaussian band offsets drawn from measured covariance plus independent flux and redshift noise. Same random draws paired across b controls.
fit: Three-start L-BFGS-B, joint normalized native-flux likelihood plus independent Gaussian redshift likelihood. Exact artificial distances; no fitted value per object.
interpretation: Single seed paired controls and restrictive source assumptions test implementation only, not coverage or astronomical validity.
